cases.explain: пророчества follows the genitive of description.

cases.sentence: Я призвал моих воинов, чтобы излить мой ___.
cases.explain: гнев is the direct object of излить (pour out), requiring accusative case.
битве follows к (to/for), which requires the dative case.
день is the subject of близок (is near), requiring nominative case.
гибель is the predicate nominative, but used as accusative in this construction.

cases.sentence: Вот наступает день Господа, жестокий день, чтобы опустошить ___.
cases.explain: страну is the direct object of опустошить (desolate), requiring accusative case.

cases.sentence: Звезды небесные и созвездия не прольют своего ___.
cases.explain: света follows the negated verb прольют (will pour/give), requiring genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я накажу ___ за его зло, нечестивых за их грехи.
cases.explain: мир is the direct object of накажу (I will punish), requiring accusative case.

reading.ru: Поднимите на голой вершине знамя, кричите им, подайте им знак рукой, чтобы шли в ворота знатных.
reading.question: What is commanded in this passage?
options: Raise a banner, cry out, and signal them to go to the gates of nobles
Build a fortress on the mountain
Prepare a feast for the army
reading.correct: Raise a banner, cry out, and signal them to go to the gates of nobles
reading.explain: The verse describes specific commands to raise a banner and signal an army.

reading.ru: Слышен шум на горах, как от огромной толпы, слышен мятежный шум царств, народов, собравшихся вместе.
reading.question: What sound is heard on the mountains?
options: The noise of a huge multitude and the sound of gathered kingdoms and peoples
The sound of music and celebration
reading.correct: The noise of a huge multitude and the sound of gathered kingdoms and peoples
reading.explain: The passage describes the tumultuous sound of kingdoms gathering.

reading.ru: Плачьте, потому что день Господа близок. Он придет, как гибель от всемогущего.
reading.question: How is the day of the Lord described as coming?
reading.explain: The verse states the Lord's day comes as devastating destruction.

reading.ru: Звезды небесные и созвездия не прольют своего света. Восходящее солнце померкнет, и луна не даст света своего.
reading.question: What happens to the celestial lights?
options: The stars, sun, and moon lose their light
reading.correct: The stars, sun, and moon lose their light
reading.explain: The passage describes cosmic darkness when sun and moon cease to give light.

reading.ru: Я накажу мир за его зло, нечестивых за их грехи.
reading.question: Who will be punished and for what?
options: The wicked will be punished for their sins and the world for its evil
reading.correct: The wicked will be punished for their sins and the world for its evil
reading.explain: God declares he will punish wickedness and evil in the world.

reading.ru: Вавилон, жемчужина царств, гордость и слава халдеев будет богом низвержен, как Содом и Гамора.
reading.question: How will Babylon be destroyed?
options: It will grow strong and endure
reading.explain: Babylon, described as a jewel of kingdoms, will be destroyed like Sodom and Gomorrah.
